The '''Royal Dutch Mathematical Society''' ('''Koninklijk Wiskundig Genootschap''' in Dutch, abbreviated as '''KWG''') was founded in 1778.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Beckers | first = Danny
 | issue = 2
 | journal = Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde
 | mr = 2454666
 | pages = 147–149
 | title = The Royal Dutch Mathematical Society since 1778
 | url = http://www.nieuwarchief.nl/serie5/pdf/naw5-2008-09-2-147.pdf
 | volume = 9
 | year = 2008}}.</ref> Its goal is to promote the development of mathematics, both from a theoretical and applied point of view.

The society publishes the quarterly journal ''[[Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde]]'', the magazine ''Pythagoras, wiskundetijdschrift voor jongeren''<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.pyth.eu/ |title=Pythagoras, wiskundetijdschrift voor jongeren |last= |first= |date= |website=pyth.eu |publisher=Koninklijk Wiskundig Genootschap |access-date=9 October 2022 |quote= |language=Dutch}}</ref> for high school children, and the scientific journal ''[[Indagationes Mathematicae]]''.

Each year the society organizes a winter [[Academic conference|symposium]] for high school teachers. Biannually Koninklijk Wiskundig Genootschap organizes the [[Dutch Mathematical Congress]]. Once every three years, the society awards the prestigious [[Brouwer Medal]] to a distinguished mathematician. This medal is named after [[L. E. J. Brouwer]].
